title: Recipe settings
queueHint: Recipes with the same queue name take turns. Leave it empty to let this one run whenever it fires.
runsSaveFirst: Save this recipe to see its runs.
runsFailed: Could not load runs. Try again in a moment.
runStopped: This run stopped at the first check.

why.math_error: The math could not be worked out. Check for a divide by zero or a typo.
why.bad_times: The number of times to repeat was not a whole number.
why.text_error: This text step got a value it could not use.
why.reward_not_manageable: Twitch only lets us change rewards made here. Pick one made in Channel points.
why.no_overlay: No overlay was open, so nothing showed.
why.queue_full: Too many runs were already waiting in this queue.
why.queue_timeout: This run waited 5 minutes in its queue and gave up.
why.queued: Sent to Twitch. Twitch does not answer here, so check the reward if it did not change.
why.limited: This hit a limit, so it did not run.
